wiki.title: Aboul Khan
wiki.extract: Aboul Bashar Khan (Bengali: আবুল বশর খান; born March 1, 1960) is an American politician of Bangladeshi descent. He is currently serving as a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives, representing Rockingham District 20 (Hampton Falls and Seabrook) since 2016. He previously represented the same district from 2012 to 2014.
